title: Handover Cost Optimization in LEO Satellite Networks using an RL-based Multiple-Column Selection Strategy via Branch-and-Price
abstract: arXiv:2611.29129v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Next-generation wireless networks increasingly rely on low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites for broad coverage and low latency, making efficient handover management essential. We formulate satellite handover as a combinatorial optimization problem, assigning each ground user to exactly one capacity-limited, visible satellite while minimizing network handover costs. We propose a reinforcement learning (RL)-based branch-and-price (B&P) framework with learned multiple-column selection (MCS) to accelerate column generation while retaining exact dynamic programming pricing. translated_title: 基于分支定价框架下强化学习多列选择策略的低轨卫星网络切换成本优化
translated_abstract: 下一代无线网络日益依赖低地球轨道（LEO）卫星来实现广覆盖和低延迟，因此高效的切换管理至关重要。我们将卫星切换问题表述为一个组合优化问题，即为每个地面用户分配恰好一颗容量受限且可见的卫星，同时最小化网络切换成本。我们提出了一种基于强化学习（RL）的分支定价（B&P）框架，通过学习得到的多列选择（MCS）策略来加速列生成过程，同时保留精确的动态规划定价。我们还开发了两种轻量级启发式策略：用于在线决策的切换感知可见时长（HAVD）策略，以及用于离线规划的拥塞感知预测（CAP）策略。此外，我们设计了一种局部搜索修复算法，通过单次翻转和逐用户轨迹重新优化，使预先计算的B&P或MCS-B&P解能够适应需求扰动，从而避免完全重新优化。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于强化学习多列选择策略的分支定价框架，用于优化低轨卫星网络的切换成本，并辅以HAVD和CAP两种轻量级启发式策略以及可适应需求扰动的局部搜索修复算法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an RL-based branch-and-price framework with learned multiple-column selection to optimize handover costs in LEO satellite networks, complemented by lightweight HAVD and CAP heuristic policies and a local-search repair algorithm that adapts solutions to demand perturbations.
